lines: We are going to be fine, I promise you both that I am looking after us.
We are safe right here, and we will get through this together.
You keep promising things while we starve, Daniel, but you're the one who took the food.
Mara, please, I am trying my best to keep us all safe.
You say you are protecting us, Daniel, but you took the food we needed.
Let us not fight among ourselves, we need to stay together to survive this.
Mara, you need to watch how you speak to me when I am trying to keep us all alive.
You keep telling us you are keeping us alive, but you are the one who took the food!
We will not fall apart now, I will take care of everything for all of us.
Grand words do not fill an empty shelf, Daniel.
Let us not fight among ourselves, we need to stay together to survive.
You always say you will take care of everything, Daniel, but you are the one who took the food.
Mara, watch your tongue, I am trying to keep us all alive in here.
You think you can silence me, Daniel, but you took the food and you're the reason we are starving.
Arguing won't put food on the shelf, Daniel, and neither will your empty promises.
Please, we cannot turn on each other like this. We will get through today if we stay calm.
We are going to make it through this together, I promise you. Just stay calm.
You went out into the night and came back with nothing, Daniel. Why did you even go?
We are staying right here together, and we will get through this without any more talk of going out.
You snuck out last night, Daniel, and came back empty-handed while we starve.
Leo, I know you are angry, but I only went out to try and find something for us.
Finding nothing and risking your life does not fix that you went behind us anyway.
Leo, please, arguing will only tear us apart when we need each other most.
Daniel, you snuck out in the dark and brought back nothing while we are all starving.
Leo, I know you are angry, but I only went out to try and find us something to eat.
Daniel, sneaking out into the dark solves nothing when we are already starving.
Daniel, you snuck out in the middle of the night and came back with nothing at all.
We must not turn on each other, we will stay together and get through this.
We are still alive, and I will keep looking after this family. We just need to stay calm.
You snuck out into the dark last night and came back with nothing at all. Why did you even go?
We must not turn on each other now, my children. We will stay together and get through this.
You snuck out into the dark last night and came back with nothing, Daniel. Putting yourself at risk like that helps no one.
Don't worry about last night, Leo. I'm going to figure something out for us.
You went out into the dark alone and brought back nothing, Daniel. Don't act like everything is fine.
I'm sorry, Leo. I just had to check, but I'll make sure we are all safe.
Daniel, your reassuring words don't change the fact that you went out there alone and came back with nothing.
Leo, stop treating me like an enemy when I'm the only one trying to fix this mess.
We are going to figure this out together, nobody is going out there again.
You went out into the night and came back with nothing, Daniel. You always make things worse.
You went out into the dark when we told you not to, Daniel, and now there is nothing left for any of us.
Leo, I had to see for myself so we wouldn't starve, I'm trying to fix this.
Trying to fix it by sneaking out and bringing back nothing doesn't help any of us, Daniel.
You went out into the dark and came back with nothing, Daniel, why did you even do it?
We are going to figure this out, I promise you all.
Empty promises don't feed anyone, Daniel. Especially after you snuck out last night against everyone's word.
You went out into the street last night for nothing, Daniel, and you can't just pretend it didn't happen.
You wanted to help us, Daniel, but we have to stay safe together.
We are going to figure this out together, I promise you.
Promises don't fix an empty shelf, Daniel, especially when you caused this.
Daniel, we are all together now, and that is what matters most.
Daniel, you snuck out last night and came back with nothing while we are starving.
Leo, stop lecturing me when you ate your share just like everyone else.
Daniel, eating your share is not the same as lying, sneaking out, and blaming others.
Leo, you do not lecture me on what is right after everything I have carried for this family.
You carried nothing except your own guilt, Daniel.
You think you know everything, Leo, but you don't understand what it takes to protect this family.
Why did you go out there last night when you knew it was dangerous, Daniel? You didn't even bring anything back.
Mara, I went because I had to find something for us to eat, not to hear your lectures.
